access: Authenticated gh CLI only; gh api REST/GraphQL and gh pr list/view. No GitHub connector, browser or direct HTTP client. Local git show used for pinned source inspection.
commands: gh api graphql --input <explicit-field paginated query JSON>
rawCache: /tmp/ra-ci-audit; run/PR enumeration page files in/tmp. Caches are temporary and not required to read committed tables; endpoint, exact IDs, log hashes/excerpts and corrective patches are retained here.
limits: Deleted GitHub runs/logs cannot be recovered from live API enumeration; no deletion audit is available. Exhaustiveness is relative to returned retained history.
Window uses run creation time. All attempts of those runs are included; no supplied pre-window CI run has an updatedAt in the window.
PR289 targets gh-pages and has no in-scope workflow run; its application-CI result is unknown, not a pass.
Branch association is used only when the merged PR head branch is unique. Checkout refs and exact SHA matches take precedence. PR membership does not establish fault introduction.
Different-SHA passing runs do not establish flakes. Source-only inspection and PR reports are not independent runtime reproduction.
No paid runner, account concurrency or queue saturation experiment was conducted.
